The '''Katalia system''' was located in the [[Thesme sector/Legends|Thesme sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to the [[Species/Legends|species]] known as [[Katalian Ape]].<ref name="JediDawn" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Katalia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was established in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square O-5.<ref name="TEA" />
